title: BOM reconciliation
criterion: Physically reconcile HW-01..HW-24: present, quantity, visible marking, seller/SKU, condition, unknown; no unexplained core-item substitution.

title: Photo inventory
criterion: Photograph both sides of the dual ESP32 board, three DS18B20 probes, BME280, MC-38, PZEM, shunt, MAX3485/TTL485, IBT-2, TEC SKU mark, V1, PSU and fuse/distribution hardware.

title: Board pin investigation
criterion: Compare board silkscreen, seller schematic/manual and ESP32-S3R2 restrictions; create pin-candidates-v0.md marking known/likely/unknown/must-test. Do not freeze GPIO yet.

title: Electrical risk ledger
criterion: List at minimum polarity, high current, fuse, PSU terminals, shunt placement, IBT-2 boot state, fan dependency, condensation, USB/back-power and RS-485 power-domain risks.

title: Legacy assumption purge
criterion: Search old physical notes for INA226, IRLB3813, two TEC, 20 L and 40 A PSU; flag them obsolete without deleting historical evidence.

title: Mechanical H0
criterion: Install and freeze V1 location, TEC mechanical stack, chamber penetration, hot side outside, sensor fixture and MC-38 alignment; no energized TEC.

title: DS18B20 enumeration
criterion: Discover exactly three expected ROM codes and record the ROM-to-role mapping; identity is the ROM, never the enumeration index.

title: Reboot identity proof
criterion: Perform at least five reboot/discovery cycles and assert the same ROM-to-role mapping across boots.

title: Acquisition implementation
criterion: Use one shared conversion phase and read all known ROMs, producing a coherent ~1 Hz thermal snapshot rather than three sequential conversions.

title: Inter-sensor consistency
criterion: Place probes under a common stable condition, collect at least 10 minutes at ~1 Hz, and compute per-probe mean/SD, pairwise mean differences and maximum disagreement; not a certified calibration.

title: BME280 check
criterion: Verify the BME280 responds, temperature/humidity are plausible, and the mounting is not immediately heated by the ESP32 or V1.

title: MC-38 door semantics
criterion: Freeze raw-input to OPEN/CLOSED semantics and test at least 20 open/close cycles for debounce and reliability.

title: XL4015 logic rail
criterion: Set and measure the XL4015 logic output before connecting sensitive modules; record no-load/load values where practical.

title: RS-485 transceiver power and pin map
criterion: Verify the installed RS-485 module VCC is 3.3 V class and map DI, RO, DE, /RE, A and B. The frozen BOM calls for MAX3485; the as-built deviation must be recorded, not hidden.

title: PZEM communication
criterion: Verify PZEM communication power, slave address, Modbus CRC and actual serial framing; if 8N1 fails, review the shipped manual revision before declaring a hardware fault.

title: 50 A profile
criterion: Read/set the PZEM current-range register and show 0x0001 or the equivalent 50 A configuration before current is evidence-grade.

title: OFF electrical envelope
criterion: With the TEC physically OFF, collect at least 10 minutes of PZEM samples and measure voltage, current/power zero and noise, and Modbus error rate.

title: Shunt installation inspection
criterion: Verify correct current path, secure terminals, no signal wire in the high-current path and the physical 50 A / 75 mV marking.

title: IBT-2 logic only
criterion: Validate the actual module pin labels, enable, PWM inputs and reset/default state without energizing the TEC; do not infer a continuous rating from the 43 A chip limit.

title: Power path build
criterion: Build 12 V PSU -> fuse box -> selected commissioning fuse -> IBT-2 -> TEC branch -> shunt/return, with the V1 fan on a protected auxiliary branch and logic via XL4015.

title: Wiring class audit
criterion: Ensure the TEC path uses 2x2.5 mm2, fan/aux uses 2x0.75 mm2 and signals use jumpers; no primary TEC current passes through PCT218 or jumpers.

title: Fuse strategy
criterion: Start with a conservative legal fuse choice derived from measured ramp/current planning; do not assume 15 A from the TEC name.

title: Boot/reset default-off
criterion: Test at least five cold boots and five resets with the power branch ready, observing PZEM current; no unintended active-branch current beyond the measured OFF envelope. This board has no reset button: warm reset uses USB-Serial/JTAG lines, cold boot uses USB power removal.

title: First conservative actuation
criterion: Use low/conservative control; check current, branch power, intended cold side, hot-side behaviour, V1 fan and terminals/wires; stop immediately on abnormality.

title: Polarity freeze
criterion: Record the physical polarity/orientation that makes the chamber side cold; never infer it from wire colour later.

title: First response trace
criterion: Capture command/applied state, V/I/P, T1/T2/T3 and time; plot electrical response and thermal direction.

title: Firmware task boundaries
criterion: Thermal, BME, door, PZEM, command state, quality, telemetry and health are separated; a PZEM timeout must not block local safety forever.

title: Device identity
criterion: Freeze device_id, boot_id, seq, uptime, firmware_version, hardware_config_id and calibration_id in the telemetry contract.

title: 1 Hz timing study
criterion: Collect at least 30 minutes; measure sample intervals, mean, P95, max gap, DS18B20 failures and PZEM failures.

title: Coherent snapshot
criterion: Each published row carries T1/T2/T3, BME T/RH, door, PZEM V/I/P/Wh, applied cooling and quality with explicit missing-state semantics.

title: Quality flags
criterion: Implement physical source states VALID/DEGRADED/INVALID/UNKNOWN; never replace missing current with a previous fresh value.

title: Command parser
failure_reason: NETWORK_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: the local source gate precedes field-level validation, so canonical duty/device/expiry checks are unreachable
criterion: Accept only the canonical schema and validate device_id, command_id, expiry, action and allowed duty/state; malformed input is rejected with a stable reason.

title: Idempotency
failure_reason: NETWORK_COMMAND_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: duplicate-canonical requires the docs/02 NETWORK source; the local console source is rejected before the idempotency store, so this cannot be physically executed in this build
criterion: The same command_id twice must produce one physical logical application and return the canonical result.

title: Expiry
failure_reason: NO_WALL_CLOCK: the exact expired-command scenario needs an issuer clock; the observed fail-closed refusal is recorded, not a PASS
criterion: An expired command is rejected with no actuation.

title: Applied state
criterion: Distinguish desired command from applied output; the ACK and telemetry include applied state.

title: Physical trace
criterion: With C/D, trace backend command -> device accept -> applied -> PZEM -> thermal response.

title: Reset while a command exists
failure_reason: NO_ACCEPTED_COMMAND_STATE: the local console record is rejected before the idempotency store; a network transport or accepted command state is required
criterion: A reboot must not automatically resume unsafe stale actuation.

title: Geometry freeze
criterion: Freeze sensor mounts, V1 position, cable paths, door alignment and chamber internal state; create a configuration photo or drawing.

title: Passive warm-up repetitions
criterion: Perform at least three valid pilot warm-up runs under similar start conditions; measure Tmean trajectory, gradient and slope.

title: Cooling step repetitions
criterion: Perform at least three valid cooling-step runs with the same core action; measure current/power, command-to-electrical delay, thermal response and recovery.

title: Repeatability summary
criterion: Compute per outcome mean, SD, CV where meaningful, min/max and trajectory overlays.

title: Initial/reset criterion candidate
criterion: Define a state-based criterion: Tmean band, gradient bound, door CLOSED, known cooling state and valid sensors.

title: Safe operating envelope
criterion: Derive allowed action state, healthy current range, healthy power range, OFF current envelope, thermal response window and stop conditions from W04-W07; do not extrapolate outside the measured region.

title: Fuse finalization
criterion: Choose 10 A, 15 A or 20 A from measured current, transients, wiring and terminal behaviour; if none is defensible the gate fails rather than improvising.

title: Hot-side sustainability
criterion: Run a sufficiently long cooling test to observe stable response, performance collapse, protection triggers and abnormal terminals/IBT-2 behaviour.

title: SAFE_LOCAL integration support
criterion: With D: remove the broker/backend, verify local Controller A inputs remain available and local output behaviour is safe.

title: Gate A package
criterion: Index all H0-H7 artifacts into the Gate A evidence package.

title: Run checklist
criterion: Before a run check hardware config, sensor identity, PZEM range, initial state, door and storage; after a run record end reason, manual intervention, anomaly and validity candidate.

title: S1 baseline
criterion: Collect approximately four valid S1 baseline runs according to the Doc 03 plan, adjusting only within the campaign plan.

title: Physical invalidation logging
criterion: Log sensor movement, manual touch, fan anomaly, missing key telemetry and unexpected power events; never delete an invalid attempt.

title: Healthy response reference
criterion: Summarize electrical active range, OFF range, thermal baseline and gradient for the healthy plant.

title: Door protocol candidates
criterion: Explore a small set of safe door durations/operations that produce a meaningful but not catastrophic thermal rise and enough trajectory for prediction.

title: Timing method
criterion: Use the MC-38 transition as machine ground truth and an operator timer as a secondary check.

title: Repeated S2 pilot
criterion: Collect at least four to six valid pilot door disturbances; measure door duration, initial T, peak, gradient, time-to-critical candidate and recovery.

title: Pair tolerance evidence
criterion: Estimate variation of initial Tmean, initial gradient and response across S2 pilots as input for B's pair-matching tolerance.

title: Horizon support
failure_reason: NO_DOOR_CRITICAL_SAMPLES: set the frozen critical Tmean threshold in Config and rerun the S2 series
criterion: Provide B the door-to-critical and controller-response distributions; do not select the ML horizon.

title: S4 method
criterion: Use a software/test mode that intentionally refuses or blocks actuation while preserving protocol visibility; never short the branch, bypass a fuse or damage the TEC.

title: S4 evidence
criterion: Produce command/intention, applied state, PZEM no-active-response and thermal non-response, proving command != electrical effect.

title: Dataset expansion
criterion: Collect additional S1/S2 runs as required by B's run plan.

title: Conditional S3 feasibility
criterion: Assess whether a safe repeatable thermal-effectiveness degradation can be created with the frozen hardware; NO-GO is acceptable, and fan obstruction must not be invented.

title: Sensor consistency recheck
criterion: Repeat the W02 consistency method and compare offsets/drift to the baseline.

title: PZEM zero/active check
criterion: Compare PZEM zero/active behaviour to the W03/W08 envelope.

title: Mechanical audit
criterion: Check sensor fixtures, V1 mounting, terminals, fuse and cable positions.

title: Hardware config signoff
criterion: List all runs under CG-HW-001 and identify any run that should not be pooled.

title: Gate G3 input
criterion: Provide A's signoff that the plant is stable enough for predictive development, or explicit blockers.

title: Command-to-electrical delay
criterion: From clean runs calculate the command-to-electrical delay distribution: median, P95 and maximum useful observed value.

title: Command-to-thermal response
criterion: Define the response-detection method with B/D and measure it across valid step runs.

title: Door-to-critical time
failure_reason: NO_DOOR_CRITICAL_SAMPLES: set the frozen critical Tmean threshold in Config and rerun the S2 series
criterion: For pilot trajectories compute the door-to-critical distribution under the frozen critical definition.

title: Passive/cooling time-constant proxy
criterion: Fit simple empirical summaries only, such as an exponential approximation or slope-based response time, and document their limitations.

title: Sensor-position QA
criterion: Verify no sensor has moved since the geometry freeze.

title: Logical ablation support
criterion: Do not unplug T2/T3 for the core A1 ablation; the same physical runs must support one-sensor and three-sensor feature sets selected logically by B.

title: Spatial statistics
criterion: Provide gradient distributions, maximum pairwise differences and disturbance-specific spatial response.

title: Pairing criterion refinement
criterion: With B freeze the final A/B initial physical matching tolerances.

title: Electrical feature integrity
criterion: Audit missing PZEM samples, sampling cadence, ON/OFF separation and power consistency.

title: A3 dataset support
criterion: Identify runs containing command, applied state, V/I/P and thermal response for B's electrical ablation.

title: PZEM reference check
criterion: If a trusted independent meter is available, compare multiple points and report bias and repeatability; otherwise report plausibility/consistency, not certified calibration.

title: PWM Go/No-Go
criterion: If energy-aware duty control is intended, test limited safe duty points for IBT-2 response, PZEM power behaviour and thermal behaviour; NO-GO is acceptable.

title: Re-run short characterization
criterion: Repeat selected OFF envelope, core ON point, response delay and S2 disturbance before predictive control.

title: Compare W7/W8 versus W16
criterion: Check current/power shift, response shift, gradient and recovery against the earlier characterization.

title: Final pair tolerances
criterion: Sign off with B the initial state, gradient, reset criterion and disturbance tolerance.

title: Controller B physical readiness
criterion: With D certify that the allowed action is still valid, there is no hardware safety issue, and H8 reactive verification is stable.

title: Shadow S2 runs
criterion: Run several S2 trajectories while Controller A remains the physical authority; B/D produce hypothetical predictive decisions and A applies only Controller A.

title: No predictive physical path
criterion: Verify from firmware logs/commands that a shadow decision is not an applied predictive action.

title: Online/offline physical alignment
criterion: Ensure raw live channels match the fields expected by B's model.

title: Plant anomaly monitoring
criterion: Flag or invalidate a run on unexpected physical drift; do not let B/D tune around a hardware malfunction.

title: Pre-run safety audit
criterion: Check fuse, fan, terminals, sensors, PZEM, chamber and applied-output default before Controller B enablement.

title: Controlled predictive dry runs
criterion: Begin with a small number of S2 runs and observe the complete chain under supervision.

title: Electrical verification
criterion: For each intervention, current enters the expected range and the OFF state returns correctly.

title: Thermal verification
criterion: Check that the expected thermal response occurs within the characterized window.

title: Abort criteria
criterion: Stop on new abnormal current, unexpected heating, repeated verification failure or physical drift; do not keep testing to obtain a successful run.

title: Run preparation
criterion: Before every run check hardware configuration, initial state, door closed, PZEM valid, storage ready and controller identity.

title: Physical execution
criterion: Follow the randomized order supplied by the campaign plan; do not change door duration, sensor placement, action magnitude or model/policy.

title: Invalid attempt logging
criterion: Record all aborted, invalid, operator-error and hardware-anomaly attempts; original attempts are retained.

title: Reset
criterion: Use the state-based reset criterion, not a fixed arbitrary waiting period.

title: Continue exact protocol
criterion: Do not change door handling, sensor placement, action magnitude or model/policy after seeing results.

title: Valid-pair completion
criterion: Complete the pre-frozen valid-pair target; rerun only under the frozen invalid-pair rule.

title: Campaign close physical audit
criterion: After the final run inspect hardware, recheck sensor identity, note damage/drift and record the final physical configuration.

title: Freeze physical campaign data
criterion: Sign the campaign manifest: hardware unchanged yes/no, exceptions and invalid attempts.

title: Physical reliability soak
criterion: Run a 2-4 hour soak (or evidence-justified duration) monitoring sensor read errors, PZEM errors, ESP stability, electrical state and thermal behaviour.

title: One-sensor degraded case
criterion: Safely simulate or disconnect one DS18B20 and verify an explicit degraded state with no silent remap.

title: PZEM unavailable
criterion: Safely remove/disable the PZEM communication path and verify electrical quality degrades explicitly and local control matches policy.

title: SAFE_LOCAL final test
criterion: With C/D, verify local operation with no broker/backend: sensors remain available and output behaviour is safe.

title: Evidence gap list
criterion: With leader/B identify physical evidence gaps.

title: Execute approved reruns
criterion: Execute only reruns allowed by Doc 03: invalid pair, missing recording, known sensor/log failure or harness defect; retain the original invalid attempt.

title: Physical limitation summary
criterion: Write the scale, single-unit, TEC/V1 uncertainty, sensor limitations, ambient effects and PZEM limits.

title: Physical demo runbook
criterion: Document the sequence: visual inspection, power-on, sensor check, PZEM check, broker/device check, short legal actuation check, demo scene, safe shutdown.

title: Recovery kit
criterion: Prepare purchased/spare fuses, jumpers, headers, tools and documentation; do not introduce unapproved core hardware.

title: Cable/label hardening
criterion: Label 12 V, 5 V, sensor bus, RS-485, TEC branch and shunt.

title: Demo rehearsals
criterion: Perform at least three full rehearsals with the team and measure setup time, thermal reset time and failure recovery.

title: Evidence package
criterion: Index Member A evidence: commissioning, characterization, A/B physical logs, faults, soak and photos.

title: Final configuration record
criterion: Freeze hardware_config_id, pin map, sensor ROMs, sensor positions, fuse, PZEM range, core allowed action and firmware version.

title: Final HIL smoke
criterion: Verify T1/T2/T3, BME, door, PZEM, default OFF, a short legal ON, current response and return OFF.

title: Handover run
criterion: Another team member follows A's runbook; A observes but does not silently fix undocumented steps.

title: Final acceptance
criterion: Deliver the hardware configuration, commissioning index, characterization report, plant timing, run protocols, limitations, physical evidence index and handover.
